text:
I had an excellent experience. The medical care was top-notch—Dr. Dentist was incredibly thorough in explaining my treatment options and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire process. The clinic is equipped with the latest technology, and the hygienists are very knowledgeable, ensuring that I received the best care possible.

In terms of service, the staff is friendly and professional from the moment you walk in. Scheduling was easy, and they made sure to accommodate my busy schedule. The clinic is also extremely clean and well-maintained, which made me feel confident in their hygiene standards.

Lastly, the pricing is very reasonable compared to other dental clinics I’ve been to. They were transparent about the costs upfront, and there were no hidden fees. They even offered flexible payment plans, which made my treatment more affordable. I highly recommend this dental Clinic for anyone looking for quality dental care at a fair price.

text: I previously had treatment with Dr. Jib, who was very kind and gentle. After having root canal treatment with Dr. Sun, I'm even more impressed. She's lovely, gentle, and very kind. She explained every step of the process, which made me feel much more at ease. 💖 …

restaurant_name: คลินิกทัตกรรมในทู
text: Not okay. The dentist made fun of my crooked tooth and laughed with the assistant while filling it. I read other comments below saying the same thing – the dentist pressed extremely hard on the tooth, it still hurts, and it was more expensive than usual even though no anesthetic was used. I'm not sure how many dentists there were; I only managed to see one when the other was facing away. The assistant was also wearing a mask. I want to give it 1 star because I've always had treatment here before and never had this problem. However, the front desk staff were polite, and my previous visits were good until this one. I'm worried about whether the same thing will happen again next time. I'm going to pass on this clinic.

text: I came here for my first dental treatment and was very impressed. The dentist and staff were very polite. I highly recommend it. The price is reasonable.

text: I was very unimpressed. The doctor was completely unrestrained, relentlessly attacking the patient. I saw the patient tensing up and feeling so much pain, yet they didn't even ask if I was okay. It was a terrible experience, unlike anything I've ever had, even at other places. I felt a complete lack of care for the patient. I do not recommend this clinic.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทัตกรรมในทู
text: I will never go back there again. I had one tooth extracted a week ago and it's still hurting. At first, I thought it was just the extraction site and took four packs of painkillers, but it was still painful. Once the wound started to heal, I realized the pain was in the other tooth next to it. I don't know if they accidentally pressed on that tooth with the pliers during the extraction; even my lip was injured from being pinched. A woman with short, pale hair did the extraction – I don't know if she was a dentist, but she was awful. I've had countless teeth extracted and never encountered anything like this. It's still hurting now, and the area around the extracted tooth is covered in sores. I do not recommend this clinic.
